raw:
The user wants a confirmation dialog for a Taiwan online banking app (Traditional Chinese, Taiwan usage). Transfer NT$12,500 to 「王小明」, irreversible after sending.

Fields:
- s1: dialog title
- s2: confirm button
- s3: cancel/abandon button (but not "算了" etc.)
- s4: explanation text

Rules to follow:
- No chatty phrasing
- Don't write 取消 as 「算了」「不用了」「不要了」 — so we can use 「取消」 itself? The rule says don't write cancel as those casual phrases. So 「取消」 is fine, or 「放棄」. Actually the field is described as 放棄按鈕 (abandon button). Common Taiwan banking: 「確認轉帳」「取消」. Could use 「取消」 or 「返回修改」.
- No apologies, no exclamation marks in errors.
- No questions as buttons or titles.
- No explaining how numbers computed, no 「請核對」「僅供參考」.
- No 「我們」, no 「你的」「您的」 unless needed.
- Don't repeat title content in explanation; don't explain obvious things.
- No mainland terms: 當前→目前, 數據→資料, 用戶→使用者, 信息→資訊, 設置→設定.
- No period at end of labels/buttons.
- Keep it short.

Title: 「確認轉帳」 — good.

Explanation: Should confirm details. Something like:

「轉帳 NT$12,500 至王小明，送出後無法取消。」

Wait — rule: don't repeat what the title already said. Title is 「確認轉帳」. Explanation mentioning transfer details is fine. But avoid 「請核對」. Avoid 「送出後無法取消」 being an apology? It's a warning, factual, fine. Should it end without period? Rule says labels and buttons no period. s4 is explanation text — may have period, but keep concise. Actually "不要在標籤與按鈕結尾加句號" only applies to labels/buttons. Explanation text can have punctuation.

Draft s4: 「將轉帳新台幣 12,500 元至王小明，送出後無法取消。」

Hmm, "將轉帳" — the amount already possibly shown elsewhere, but the dialog needs to state it. The user asked to write the confirmation dialog; including amount and recipient in the description makes sense since they said don't repeat title's words. Title 「確認轉帳」 says "confirm transfer"; description gives details: amount, recipient, irrevocable.

Could also use format: 「轉帳金額 NT$12,500\n收款人 王小明」 but only one string s4. Keep single line.

Alternative s4: 「轉出 NT$12,500 至王小明，送出後無法取消。」

Avoid 「您的」. Fine.

Buttons: s2 「確認轉帳」? That repeats title. Maybe title 「轉帳確認」 and button 「確認轉帳」? Rule: don't repeat title. Better title: 「確認轉帳」, buttons: 「送出」 / 「取消」. Common Taiwan banking: 「確認」 and 「取消」. Or 「立即轉帳」 too chatty? 「送出」 is clean.

s3: 「取消」 — allowed since the prohibition is only against casual variants like 算了/不用了/不要了. 「取消」 is standard UI term, not chatty.

s2: 「確認轉帳」 vs title 「確認轉帳」 duplicates. Let's set:
- s1: 「轉帳確認」? Hmm "轉帳確認" sounds slightly odd; 「確認轉帳」 more natural as title. Then s2: 「送出」? But 送出 could be ambiguous. Taiwan banks often use 「確認」. Title 「轉帳確認」 is used actually (確認頁). Many Taiwan banking apps use 「交易確認」 or 「確認交易」.

Let me pick:
- s1: 「確認轉帳」
- s2: 「送出」
- s3: 「取消」
- s4: 「將轉出 NT$12,500 至王小明，送出後無法取消。」

Check rules:
- No chatty: ok.
- 取消 not as 算了: ok.
- No apology/exclamation: ok.
- No questions: ok.
- No explaining computation, no 請核對: ok.
- Not describing unseen: ok.
- No 約: amount is exact, ok.
- No 我們/你的: ok.
- Not repeating title: title says 確認轉帳, s4 says 將轉出... slightly overlapping with 轉帳 word but different info. Fine. Actually "將轉出" contains 轉... acceptable.
- No mainland terms: ok. 「新台幣」 vs NT$: NT$ is fine in Taiwan apps. Could write 「新臺幣 12,500 元」. Taiwan official: 新臺幣. Apps often NT$. Either fine.
- No period at end of labels/buttons: buttons have none.
- Brevity: ok.

Maybe s4 better: 「轉帳 NT$12,500 至王小明，送出後無法取消。」 Hmm "轉帳" repeats title word. Alternative: 「金額 NT$12,500，收款人王小明，送出後無法取消。」 But "請核對" banned; we're not asking to verify. This is concise and info-dense. But "收款人" is fine Taiwan term. Could structure: 「轉出 NT$12,500 給王小明，送出後無法取消。」 "給" is slightly colloquial but normal.

I'll go with: 「將轉出 NT$12,500 至王小明，送出後無法取消。」

Actually maybe include 新台幣? NT$ is standard. Keep NT$12,500.

Final JSON:
{"s1":"確認轉帳","s2":"送出","s3":"取消","s4":"將轉出 NT$12,500 至王小明，送出後無法取消。"}

Hmm, "送出" as confirm button while s4 says 送出後無法取消 — consistent. Good.

One more check: rule "不要重複標題已經說過的話" — s4 says 將轉出... The title 「確認轉帳」 states action; s4 states details and consequence. Not repetition.

Output only JSON.</think>{"s1":"確認轉帳","s2":"送出","s3":"取消","s4":"將轉出 NT$12,500 至王小明，送出後無法取消。"}

parsed.s4: 將轉出 NT$12,500 至王小明，送出後無法取消。
